name: QAnon
summary: QAnon is an online movement built on the posts of an anonymous 'Q', who claims that a secret cabal of ruling elites controls governments, that Donald Trump and the military are secretly fighting it, and that a coming 'Storm' will expose and punish it. Politically it is a populist, anti-elite and nationalist movement that uses religious language; its few stated positions are opposition to a 'one world order' and to international bodies, defence of gun rights and the electoral college, hostility to open borders, and support for term limits.
scope: The movement around Q's posts on 4chan, 8chan and 8kun (October 2017 to November 2020), as described by Foertsch et al. (political populism using religious rhetoric), Papasavva et al. and Zihiri et al. Answers rest on the posts themselves, chiefly Q's long July 2020 post and its January 2018 list of the 'plan to destroy America'. Individual followers' views and Trump's own positions are excluded. Q mostly asks cryptic questions, so most statements are unanswered.

limit-guns.rationale: Q's July 2020 post lists 'removal 2nd amendment' among the plans of the cabal and says its aim is to remove citizens' ability to defend themselves; Q also asks why Democrats want to abolish the 2nd amendment.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Q presents an armed citizenry as the reason enemies dare not invade and as what the cabal wants to remove, so a disarmed citizenry under a state arms monopoly contradicts it.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Q names the UN, WHO, WTO, ICC and NATO as organisations 'all meant to weaken the United States' and part of a one-world order.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Q condemns a 'one world order [destruction of national sovereignty]' and describes the EU as formed by con, each member ceding sovereignty to Brussels.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Q treats international bodies including the ICC as built to weaken the United States and condemns the destruction of national sovereignty, though it never discusses courts' precedence directly.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Q lists the ICC among the international organisations meant to weaken the United States; it does not discuss trying leaders for aggression as such.

collective-defense.rationale: Q calls the NATO and EU 'attack on one is an attack on all' pledge a sales pitch built on fear and control.

open-borders.rationale: Q's list of the 'plan to destroy America' includes 'Open border' and 'Open borders', and the wall and border enforcement are presented as the President's priority.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Q lists 'Removal of electoral college' as one of the cabal's steps to destroy America, which opposes electing the head of state directly instead of through the electoral college.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Q's central claim is that corrupt and sinister elements have infiltrated government at the highest levels; the scholarship describes the theory as a secret cabal of ruling elites.

term-limits.rationale: Q asks why the President is pushing for term limits and answers 'TIME = CORRUPTION'.

military-superiority.rationale: Q lists cutting military funding, selling off military assets, closing overseas bases and killing NASA as steps to weaken US military capacity; it treats US military strength as vital.

party-controls-media.rationale: Q lists 'Destruction of opposing MSM/other news outlets (censoring)' among the cabal's aims and condemns 'free speech manipulation'.
